name: Gemcitabine + CISplatin (UK-ABC-02)
cyclesNote: up to 8 cycles (a maximum of 6 months of therapy per UK-ABC-02; DeVita lines 114828 to 114829)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The cisplatin/gemcitabine cytotoxic backbone is NOT biomarker-restricted. Biliary molecular targets - FGFR2 fusions/rearrangements, IDH1 mutation, HER2 (ERBB2), BRAF V600E, MSI-H/dMMR, and NTRK fusions - are tested to guide targeted or immunotherapy options (predominantly in the subsequent-line setting), not to select or gate the gemcitabine/cisplatin backbone. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Biliary Tract Cancers v1.2026, Targeted therapy (BIL-C 3 of 5) and Principles of Molecular Testing; DeVita 12th ed. Ch. 37 (FGFR2 and IDH1 are the most advanced targets, more common in intrahepatic CCA).

premedications.name: Cisplatin hydration
premedications.notes: pre- and post-cisplatin IV hydration to prevent nephrotoxicity.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: cisplatin is highly emetogenic; give guideline-tier antiemetic prophylaxis before each cisplatin dose.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: cisplatin-based, high emetogenic risk on days 1 and 8; prophylaxis required.
Cisplatin hydration protocol; monitor renal function, magnesium, and electrolytes.
Audiometry/neuropathy assessment as clinically indicated (cisplatin oto- and neurotoxicity).
monitoring: CBC before each dose (days 1 and 8) - myelosuppression
renal function (creatinine/GFR), magnesium, and electrolytes before each cisplatin dose
peripheral neuropathy and hearing assessment - cisplatin

doseModificationRules.condition: myelosuppression or renal impairment on day 1 or day 8
doseModificationRules.text: Review required; hold or reduce per protocol for cytopenias or rising creatinine. Consider carboplatin substitution if cisplatin-ineligible (NCCN BIL-C footnote g). Physician decides.

drugs.name: Gemcitabine
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. Ch. 37, lines 114827 to 114829 (UK-ABC-02). Gemcitabine 1,000 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 8 of a 21-day cycle.

provenance.locator: lines 114827 to 114828 (Ch. 37 Systemic Therapy for Cholangiocarcinoma: gemcitabine 1,000 mg/m2 with cisplatin 25 mg/m2, both IV on days 1 and 8 every 21 days, max 6 months; UK-ABC-02)

drugs.name: CISplatin
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. Ch. 37, lines 114827 to 114829 (UK-ABC-02). CISplatin 25 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 8 of a 21-day cycle. ISMP tall-man (CISplatin). Requires pre- and post-hydration; monitor for nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, and peripheral neuropathy. If cisplatin-ineligible, carboplatin may be substituted per NCCN BIL-C footnote g.

provenance.locator: lines 114827 to 114828 (Ch. 37: cisplatin 25 mg/m2 with gemcitabine 1,000 mg/m2, both IV on days 1 and 8 every 21 days; UK-ABC-02)
